page.layout: One page of text, top block of running text, then three signature lines (names), then a woodcut ornament with no text. Signature mark at the foot right.

main_text.p: …tandem videamus ac exultemus. Quod faxit Deus! Cujus paternæ curæ vos vestraque com-mendamus.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament (a cornucopia-like fruit and foliage design with scrolls and ribbons) carries no text and is not transcribed. The first line is cut off at the left edge by the scan, so the opening word is a fragment ("…tam"). The left strip of the scan shows the neighbouring page's edge and was not transcribed. Faint show-through from the reverse side on the right was ignored. The signature mark "L A G-" at the foot is read from a small, faint print and may be imprecise.
